name: Page Transition Wipe
use: Sitewide page-to-page wipe: an ink panel rises over the page on an internal link click, then lifts off the next page as soon as its HTML is ready.
notes: Over the 8 KB budget (9.8 KB) because of the link skip rules (modifier/middle clicks, _blank, download, same-page hash, mailto/tel, external, commerce paths, files, galleries/lightboxes, opt-out), bfcache handling and the three fail-safes. Full page loads only, no SPA. Coexists with preloaders 01-03 when they stay once per session.
